gross_amount_at_minimum.meaning: campaign creator supplies a gross amount exactly at the per-hour minimum so it passes rewardTokenMinAmounts validation

nonzero_protocol_fees.meaning: non-zero protocol fees apply to the campaign amount

net_emits_below_floor.meaning: campaign is created and its stored/distributed net amount per epoch is less than the guardian-configured rewardTokenMinAmounts floor

assumptions: The campaign creator submits campaign creation with the minimum valid gross amount.
Protocol fees are computed and subtracted after the minimum check, producing campaignAmountMinusFees.
The scenario is conditional: it occurs whenever creators choose the minimum valid gross amount.

unresolved.description: Exact fee value and resulting net amount are not quantified, so the below-floor relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.

limitations: The below-floor relation is qualitative because the report gives no numeric fee or net amount.
No explicit actor authorization statement is given; campaign creator role is inferred from the description.
